architectural_reason: Develop the newly authored inhabited bridge between two grounded volumes, rather than again returning to the curved stepped family. Its actual ground plans and section show two supports and an upper crossing, while the bridge depth, connection level and setbacks remain consequential design questions. The fresh jury retained this candidate at its existing score; selection is for deliberate architectural exploration, not a changed ranking. Compare wider, lower, recessed and oblique connections and remeasure the residual parking shortfall for each child.
